summary: Secret handle lease rules are implemented as security_execution::secret_runtime. The runtime now has SecretHandle metadata, boundary inspection for plan/observation/memory/audit/model/projection surfaces, raw secret rejection or redaction by surface, explicit narrow one-shot SecretUseLease validation, broad approval rejection, and handle-only audit records.

acceptance.criterion: secret://handle references remain visible where needed.
Raw secret-like values are rejected or redacted before model, memory, and audit summaries.
acceptance.evidence: raw_secret_values_are_rejected_or_redacted_before_boundaries rejects model context and memory raw secrets while redacting audit/projection summaries.

acceptance.criterion: Secret-use requires an explicit capability lease.
acceptance.evidence: secret_use_requires_explicit_narrow_capability_lease rejects missing lease and creates a one-shot lease from exact CapabilityLease metadata.

acceptance.criterion: Secret-use cannot be granted by broad approval tokens.
acceptance.evidence: broad_approval_and_wildcard_lease_cannot_grant_secret_use and safety::secret::broad_approval_tokens_cannot_grant_secret_use reject wildcard resource and parameter hash.

acceptance.criterion: Secret fixtures remain covered by safety gate.
acceptance.evidence: cargo test -p agentd safety::secret passes 5 targeted tests and cargo test -p agentd passes 114 tests.
